title: rwgpu playtest file
description: Scripted input plus expectations, run by `rwgpu test`. `run`, `shot` and `inspect` accept it as `--input`.

test.description: Which scene, how long, which seed.

scene.description: Scene to run. Default: the project's main_scene.

frames.description: Number of frames (steps) to run. Default: 300.

seed.description: Overrides the project and scene seed.

items.description: One input event. Use exactly one of `press`, `hold`, `tap` or `camera`. Input at frame N is applied by step N (the step from frame N to N+1). A `camera` move at frame N happens before that frame's taps.

frame.description: Frame at which the input happens.

press.description: Press and release an action within the frame.

hold.description: Hold an action down for `for` frames.

for.description: With `hold`: number of frames to hold. Default: 1.

tap.description: Tap the screen at pixel [x, y]; hits the topmost enabled entity drawn there.

camera.description: Move the camera: `{ turn = 90 }`, `{ zoom = 2 }`, `{ pan = [1, 0] }`, `{ view = "perspective" }`, or several at once. What a later tap hits depends on it.

turn.description: Turn by this many degrees about the vertical line through the camera's center. Default: 0.

zoom.description: Multiply the zoom by this (it stays within 0.125–16). Default: 1.0.

pan.description: Move the camera's center by this many cells [x, y]. Default: [0, 0].

items.description: A check at `frame`. Entity state (`entity` with `pos`/`enabled`/`solid`/`props`/`text`), a count of entities made from a prefab (`prefab` with `count`, optionally at `pos`), or the event log (`event`, filtered by `entity`, `other`, `signal`, `reason`, counted with `at_least`/`at_most`). Events are counted if they happened *before* `frame`: an event logged as `[N]` happened in step N and counts from `frame = N + 1`. `entity` matches the event's subject and `other` its other party (`rwgpu explain events` lists both for every kind).

frame.description: When to check. Default: the last frame.

props.description: Expected values of these props (others are ignored).

text.description: Expected label text as shown, with placeholders filled in (`"Coins: 3/3"`).

prefab.description: Without `event`: count the enabled entities made from this prefab (placed or spawned), optionally only those at `pos`, checked with `count` (at least one when absent). With `event`: only count events about the prefab: its spawns, refused spawns (`blocked`) and skipped spawns, and events whose subject is a copy of it (`event = "skipped", prefab = "barn"` = barn spawns stopped by a `when`).

count.description: With `prefab`: exactly this many. `count = 0` with `pos` asserts nothing of that prefab stands there.

event.description: Count events of this kind that happened before `frame`.

other.description: With `event`: only events whose other party is this entity (the blocker of `blocked`, the actor of `trigger`, the emitter of `action`).

signal.description: With `event`: only count events about this signal.

reason.description: With `event = "blocked"`: only count refusals for this reason (e.g. `solid`, not `cooldown`; `push` = a pushable could not be pushed; `terrain`/`occupied`/`edge` = a spawn could not be placed; `funds` = it could not be paid for).

changed.description: With `event = "action"`: `true` counts only actions that really changed something (a door that opened, a prop with a new value), `false` only those that changed nothing (`enable` on an enabled entity, `set` to the same value). Without it, every time the connection fired counts.

at_least.description: With `event`: minimum number of matching events (0 when only `at_most` is given). Default: 1.

at_most.description: With `event`: maximum number of matching events. `at_most = 0` asserts it never happened.

expect.description: Checks on world state or the event log.

items.description: Render a frame and compare it with a reference PNG. Create or refresh references with `rwgpu test --update-refs`.

frame.description: Frame to render. Default: the last frame.

reference.description: Reference PNG, relative to the project root (e.g. tests/refs/smoke.png).
